resolved_conflicts.explanation: OpenStreetMap still has a named tower point at the spot, and its source record reads standing; the register's Gone is followed, since a map point does not show whether a structure stands.

sources.title: River Road Ramblings: Sterling Fire Tower on the St Croix River

notes_for_editor: The 1932 and 1954 dates rest on one personal blog. The late-1930s 85-foot replacement is undated, so it is in the story but not in events. The blog's 100-foot figure is not clearly cab-floor height, so no height_m. The 1970 account is written from memory. A Sterling Eureka and Laketown Historical Society Facebook post about the DNR selling its towers, possibly for a cell tower, could not be read (login wall); worth a human check for fate and the site today. The blog also mentions a recent video made at the tower with no date; not used.
